title: Nightly snapshot: captured Earned and Remaining use the identical computation as the on-screen report for the capture date
custom_preconds:
1. An open ZZAUTOTEST work order with known approved labor (partly clocked) and approved parts (partly received) exists and is left UNCHANGED across the capture.
2. You can read the on-screen report on the capture date and the stored snapshot row afterward.
custom_steps:
1. On the capture date, note the work order's Earned and Remaining on the Work In Progress report.
2. After the nightly capture, read the same work order's captured Earned and Remaining in the snapshot row.
3. Compare the pairs.
custom_expected: 1. The captured Earned equals the on-screen Earned and the captured Remaining equals the on-screen Remaining, to the cent — the snapshot uses the identical computation (Earned per S4-R19, Remaining per S4-R20), so the two can never diverge for a given work order on the capture date.
